title: Key transit routes
steps: Carrasco Airport → Montevideo: Official airport taxi (fixed-fare structure) from the taxi desk in arrivals, ≈25–30 min, or a public bus to Tres Cruces terminal/downtown, ≈45–60 min — ⚠ confirm the current line number at the terminal.
Montevideo → Colonia del Sacramento: COT bus from Tres Cruces terminal, ≈2h20m, frequent departures from 05:00. {{fact:cot-colonia-579-uyu}}. Buy at the terminal or cot.com.uy.
Montevideo → Punta del Este: COT bus from Tres Cruces, ≈2h, frequent departures from 04:45. {{fact:cot-punta-466-uyu}}. Same booking channel.
Getting around Montevideo: Ciudad Vieja and the Rambla are walkable; city buses (STM network) and taxis/Uber cover longer hops like Bodega Bouza in Melilla (≈15 min from downtown).
Getting around Punta del Este: The peninsula, harbor, and Playa Brava/Mansa are walkable; a taxi or rental car makes more sense for Casapueblo/Punta Ballena (≈15 km) and La Barra (≈8 km).
